goal.objective: Independently determine whether exact Revision 22 closes the Revision 21 provenance failure and npm 11 closed-environment defect without a new trust, cleanup, reconstruction, or test-quality bypass.

assumptions.statement: Executable provenance, offline-cache provenance, operating-system isolation, permission enforcement, and hostile same-user resistance remain external-host duties.

assumptions.statement: The producer package, handoff, verifier report, and test results are authenticated evidence but do not supply this review's semantic verdict.

assumptions.statement: The reviewer has no write authority and reports defects without repairing reviewed bytes.

evidenceRequirements.description: Provide package and source authentication, disposition of every required review point, bypass analysis, test-quality analysis, residual host boundaries, and a concrete pass or correction route.
